fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance that is visible from both directions on the street.
• Trim vegetation along the front driveway to maintain clear width and overhead clearance for emergency vehicles.
• Mark the gate or access point to the rear of the property with a reflective indicator so responders can locate it quickly at night.
• Keep any rear gate unlocked or secured with a breakaway latch to allow responders to reach the detached structure without delay.
• Clear a walking path between the main residence and the detached structure wide enough for responders carrying equipment.
• Thin dense vegetation between the two structures so responders have a direct line of sight and unobstructed movement between them.
• Post the property address visibly on both the main residence and the detached structure if they are not currently marked.
• Keep the vehicle parking area clear of stored items that would block repositioning of emergency vehicles on site.
• Trim shrubs or plantings along the walkway so it remains passable for responders moving between the front and sides of the property.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from large trees that hang directly over or within a few feet of the structure's roof and walls.
• Thin trees within the cluster closest to the structure to create visible gaps between individual tree canopies.
• Remove any shrubs growing directly against the base of the structure.
• Clear dead leaves, branches, and other loose plant material that has collected against the structure's walls or foundation.
• Trim the lower branches of scattered trees near the structure to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Keep shrubs scattered near the structure trimmed low and separated from one another rather than allowed to grow together.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material from around outbuildings or secondary structures on the property.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation along their full length.
• Maintain the open terrain areas around the structure by keeping them free of accumulating dead grass, brush, or debris.
• Separate any woodpiles, equipment, or stored materials from the structure and move them away from vegetation.
